subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability, success criteria & procurement checkpoints
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@finlytics.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: POC kickoff — available windows this week?

Monica / Redwood team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The stakeholders at FinLytics are keen to get a short POC started to validate integration and cost estimates. Can we lock a kickoff next week that includes AE, SE, our procurement lead, and security? High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm success criteria and duration (30/60-day POC)
- Walkthrough of data handling and retention options
- Access plan for our engs to hit a sandbox

Who from your side should we expect, and what slots do you have available? I can round up internal attendees once we have a few slots.

Best,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Data Platform
FinLytics

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — available windows this week?

Hi Alex —

Thanks — excited to get this going. Proposed attendees from our side:
- Monica Patel (AE) — overall POC owner, timeline & success criteria
- Dev Patel (SE) — technical kickoff and onboarding
- Laura Bennett (CS) — success criteria instrumentation and evaluation plan

We can do a 60–90 minute kickoff to cover scope and technical prerequisites. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 14 Sep: 10:00–11:30
- Wed 15 Sep: 15:00–16:30
- Thu 16 Sep: 08:30–10:00

Preliminary success criteria (for discussion):
1) End-to-end demo of data ingest -> Redwood inference with synthetic dataset (latency < 250ms for 1k qps sampling)
2) Embedding quality sample (top-10 nearest neighbor precision)
3) Cost estimate for 30-day pilot + runbook for scaling to prod

Timeline proposal: kickoff (week 0) -> sandbox setup (week 1) -> verification tests (week 2) -> evaluation (week 3–4). Owners and acceptance gates are listed inline in the attached POC-SOW-draft-v1.pdf.

Two asks for you now:
1) Please confirm procurement contact (for PO and terms) and security contact (for SOC2 / data retention).
2) Which environment should Dev target for the sandbox (cloud region / VPC peering allowed?)

I've attached the SOW draft for quick review.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
Attachments: POC-SOW-draft-v1.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finlytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@finlytics.com>, security@finlytics.com
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — available windows this week?

Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Wed 15 Sep 15:00–16:30 PT works best for us — please pencil that.

Procurement contact: Ruth Park (ruth.park@finlytics.com) — I've looped her on this thread. Security: please include security@finlytics.com (they'll triage SOC2 evidence requests).

A few immediate notes from our side:
- We'll need a short SOC2 summary and data retention policy before we start ingesting real data.
- Sandbox access: prefer a dedicated VPC peering route (we'll share CIDR) but can accept temporary SSH bastion if peering takes time.

I'll confirm finalized attendees (eng + procurement) by EOD Monday.

Cheers,
Alex

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and tech pre-reqs

Alex / team —

Quick technical note ahead of Wed 15 Sep session (planning for the 15:00 PT slot):

Recommended kickoff agenda (60–90m):
- 0–10m: Intros & objective alignment (Monica)
- 10–30m: Architecture & access model (Dev)
- 30–55m: Data ingest, SDKs, and sample run (Rishi + FinLytics engs)
- 55–75m: Success criteria, measurement plan, next actions (Laura)

Pre-reqs for sandbox work:
- VPC CIDR or temp SSH bastion (we can support both)
- API token provisioning process (we'll need a contact for on-call key exchange)
- If you'll test with private data, an agreed sink and retention TTL (we provide encryption at rest by default)

I've attached a quick checklist and a README for engineers: Prelim-Security-Checklist.xlsx, k8s-access-README.md. Sharing pointers here so the engs can prep.

Also, to set expectations: the sandbox setup (peering + token exchange) typically takes 2–3 business days if approvals are ready. If procurement needs a formal SOW/PO before access, please flag so we can align timelines.

--
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Prelim-Security-Checklist.xlsx, k8s-access-README.md

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: POC kickoff — Wed 15 Sep 15:00 PT (calendar invite + next steps)

Alex / Ruth / security team —

Confirming the kickoff for Wed, 15 Sep 2027 at 15:00–16:30 PT. I've sent a calendar invite (Google Calendar: "FinLytics — Redwood POC Kickoff") and added a short agenda. Attendees from Redwood: Monica (AE), Dev (SE), Rishi (Platform), Laura (CS). From FinLytics: Alex + engs + Ruth (procurement) + security.

Immediate next steps:
- Ruth: please confirm PO cadence / whether a purchase order is required before we begin sandbox provisioning.
- security@finlytics.com: we'll upload a SOC2 summary and the Prelim-Security-Checklist to a shared folder before the meeting.
- Alex / engs: share preferred sandbox CIDR or indicate if you want a temporary bastion.

I've also attached the SOW draft and included a DocuSign link for streamlined signatures: https://docusign.com/signer/embedded?doc=DL-2027-541. If procurement prefers a PDF for internal review first, we'll send that to Ruth directly.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
